title: card.discarded payload, schemaVersion 1
description: A game event from the Shuffler: a card was discarded to the graveyard. Same shape as card.played.v1 — graveyard *is* this event's meaning. Keeps face (unlike card.returned.v1) because a discard is public: it shows the card, it doesn't just remove it (two-faced-cards watch point 19). Card identity is the Scryfall ID (definition) plus a Shuffler-minted instance GUID (this particular Forest, for this game). Which seat discarded it lives on the envelope's initiator, not repeated here.

scryfallId.description: Definition: the exact printing — oracle identity, all faces, all names, all images derivable.

instanceId.description: Instance: this particular physical-ish card, minted per game at game start. Opaque — distinct from the Shuffler's internal gameCardIndex (see the sibling `gameCardIndex` property below), which is a rank in a decklist array, not a stable per-card identity.

face.description: Face is card state, not identity — but MDFCs are discarded as a chosen face, so it rides along.

frontImageUrl.description: Blessed scaffolding convenience: render without a Scryfall lookup.

backImageUrl.description: Present (non-null) exactly when the card has a printed back face — null, never omitted, when it doesn't (two-faced-cards watch point 17).

cardName.description: Blessed scaffolding convenience: display without a Scryfall lookup.

owner.description: The seatId of the player this card belongs to — matching card.played.v1's `owner` field. Grants no capability — any player can still move any card; it makes 'whose card is this' a fact the shape carries.

isCommander.description: Whether this card is one of its owner's commanders.

gameCardIndex.description: The card's index in the Shuffler's initial decklist array (its alphabetical rank in that list) — not library order, which is shuffled. Optional: older senders may omit it, and no receiver is required to use it.
